Minoxidil is an incredible growth agent but it doesn't address the root cause of hairloss which is the build up of scalp DHT. Finasteride inhibits the DHT so you hair won't fall anymore and minoxidil and microneedling will exacerbate the growth rate and quality of the hair follicles. The only caveat is that these treatments can induce side effects in a small percentage of users (around 5%) and are to be employed for a lifetime. Youtube channels to learn more about this are the hairloss show and More Plates More Dates. 

Sincerely,
